deep-void.$description: Deep Void — Page canvas, section backgrounds, footer — the absolute darkness that lets all other layers float

abyss.$description: Abyss — Hero section canvas, deepest background layer, terminal/code surfaces

carbon.$description: Carbon — Button surface, near-black accent fill

obsidian.$description: Obsidian — Elevated button surface, card depth, input fields on dark canvas

slate-edge.$description: Slate Edge — Hairline borders, card outlines, divider rules — the primary border that does elevation work

iron.$description: Iron — Card surface background, subtle elevated panel

fog.$description: Fog — Secondary borders, stronger dividers between content blocks

mercury.$description: Mercury — Muted borders, inactive form outlines

ash.$description: Ash — Mid-gray borders, icon strokes at reduced contrast

pearl.$description: Pearl — Body text, secondary copy, muted nav labels, icon fills at 183 instances — the workhorse neutral

moss.$description: Moss — Tertiary headings, low-emphasis section titles that should recede

snow.$description: Snow — Primary headings, primary text, button text, nav labels — the foreground voice

terminal-green.$description: Terminal Green — Primary CTA fill (Sign up for GitHub) — the one warm color in the system, deliberately evokes a terminal cursor

phosphor.$description: Phosphor — Green wash for highlight backgrounds, decorative bands, and soft emphasis behind content. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

canopy.$description: Canopy — Gray wash for highlight backgrounds, decorative bands, and soft emphasis behind content. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

ultraviolet.$description: Ultraviolet — Featured card border accent — signals the selected or highlighted card in a grid

sky.$description: Sky — Body text accent, icon fills, link text — the cool companion to warm green, 73 instances making it the second-most-present chromatic color

cobalt.$description: Cobalt — Link/button accent at low frequency, icon-secondary token — reserved for marketing moments

mona-sans.$description: Primary interface and display typeface — custom GitHub typeface with variable weight axis. Weight 425 at 64px display is the signature choice: lighter than conventional bold but heavier than regular, creating a confident but engineered voice. Mona Sans Mono at 12px uppercase handles micro-labels (nav, button tags) with its 0.015em tracking giving labels a technical, stamped feel.

mona-sans-mono.$description: Monospaced companion for code-related labels, small-caps tags, and terminal-feel micro-text

mona-sans-vf.$description: Mona Sans VF — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
